title: Pet Care ABC
hook: Care fits the species, every day.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cozy 3D pet-care storybook, warm home palette, friendly animals and supplies, clean safe scenes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child helping with pet care under adult responsibility
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written species-specific care; medical/grooming tools adult-guided
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: care cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe point/pretend gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft marimba paw-step and one warm bell after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft marimba paw-step and one warm bell after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Pet Care ABC a daily-needs routine: species-appropriate habitat, fresh water, food, exercise, grooming, identification and veterinary care come before toys, with each animal's needs kept distinct.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Morning-to-evening care checklist asks what the animal needs rather than what looks cute.
